# EasyBib

> EasyBib is a free bibliography generator and academic writing platform supporting MLA, APA, and Chicago citation styles with integrated grammar checking and plagiarism detection.

EasyBib provides students and researchers with tools for citation management, essay checking, and writing assistance. The platform offers comprehensive guides for multiple citation formats and supports various source types including websites, books, journals, and videos.

## Key Topics

- MLA Format
- APA Format
- Citation Generator
- Works Cited
- In-Text Citations
- Chicago Style
- Annotated Bibliography
- Grammar Check
- Plagiarism Detection
- Writing Assistant
- Research Papers
- Academic Writing
- Bibliography
- Citation Guides
- Student Writing Tools

## Core Tools

- [EasyBib: Free Bibliography Generator](https://www.easybib.com): Homepage for free citation generator supporting MLA, APA, Chicago styles
- [Dashboard](https://www.easybib.com/dashboard): User dashboard for managing citations and accessing EasyBib tools
- [Essay Checker: Free Grammar & Plagiarism Check](https://www.easybib.com/grammar-and-plagiarism): Free grammar checker and plagiarism detection tool with citation support
- [Free Writing Assistant](https://www.easybib.com/writing-assistant): Free writing assistant with grammar suggestions and text editing tools

## MLA Format Guides

- [MLA Format: Everything You Need to Know Here](https://www.easybib.com/guides/citation-guides/mla-format): Comprehensive MLA format guide covering paper formatting and citations
- [MLA Works Cited: Develop an MLA Works Cited Page](https://www.easybib.com/guides/citation-guides/mla-format/how-to-format-a-mla-works-cited-list): Guide to creating MLA works cited pages with formatting instructions
- [MLA In-Text Citations](https://www.easybib.com/guides/citation-guides/mla-format/in-text-citations): Tutorial on MLA in-text citations including parenthetical and narrative formats
- [Creating an MLA Bibliography](https://www.easybib.com/guides/citation-guides/mla-format/bibliography-format-mla): Guide to MLA bibliography formatting with visual examples and guidelines
- [MLA Annotated Bibliography Format](https://www.easybib.com/guides/citation-guides/mla-format/annotated-bibliography-format-mla): Instructions for formatting MLA annotated bibliographies with examples
- [MLA Citation Examples](https://www.easybib.com/guides/citation-guides/mla-format/mla-citation): Collection of MLA citation examples for various source types

## MLA Source-Specific Guides

- [How to Cite a Website in MLA](https://www.easybib.com/guides/citation-guides/mla-format/how-to-cite-a-website-mla): Complete guide to citing websites in MLA format with examples
- [How to Cite a Book in MLA](https://www.easybib.com/guides/citation-guides/mla-format/how-to-cite-a-book-mla): Guide for citing books in MLA format with in-text and full citations
- [How to Cite a Journal Article in MLA](https://www.easybib.com/guides/citation-guides/mla-format/how-to-cite-a-journal-mla): Instructions for citing journal articles in MLA with real examples
- [How to Cite a YouTube Video in MLA](https://www.easybib.com/guides/citation-guides/mla-format/how-to-cite-video-youtube-mla): Guide to citing YouTube videos and online media in MLA format

## APA Format Guides

- [APA Reference Page: How to Format Works Cited](https://www.easybib.com/guides/citation-guides/apa-format/how-to-format-an-apa-reference-page): Guide to formatting APA reference pages and works cited lists
- [APA In-Text Citations](https://www.easybib.com/guides/citation-guides/apa-format/apa-in-text-citation): Tutorial on creating APA in-text citations with clear examples
- [APA Annotated Bibliography Format](https://www.easybib.com/guides/citation-guides/apa-format/annotated-bibliography-format-apa): Guide to formatting APA annotated bibliographies with visual examples
